    requires brackets != null
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < brackets.Length ==> (brackets[i] == '(' || brackets[i] == ')')
    ensures result == (exists n :: 0 <= n <= brackets.Length && count_opening_brackets(brackets, n) == count_closing_brackets(brackets, n) && forall m :: 0 <= m < n ==> count_opening_brackets(brackets, m) >= count_closing_brackets(brackets, m))

    // Helper function to count opening brackets
    method count_opening_brackets(brackets: string, n: int) returns (count: int)
        requires 0 <= n <= brackets.Length
        ensures count == (if n == 0 then 0 else count_opening_brackets(brackets, n - 1) + (if brackets[n - 1] == '(' then 1 else 0))

    // Helper function to count closing brackets
    method count_closing_brackets(brackets: string, n: int) returns (count: int)
        requires 0 <= n <= brackets.Length
        ensures count == (if n == 0 then 0 else count_closing_brackets(brackets, n - 1) + (if brackets[n - 1] == ')' then 1 else 0))
```
